name: f1rstaid
description: A RAG-based smart assistant for F-1 students navigating U.S. immigration regulations.

paragraphs: A smart assistant for F-1 students navigating U.S. immigration regulations, powered by AI.
Live demo: f1rstaid-064025a9fcc1.herokuapp.com — try it free (a few questions on a shared key), or bring your own OpenAI key for unlimited use.
Demo video (1.5 min walkthrough): watch it here. The video lives on the pr-assets branch so it stays out of main's history.
features: Deterministic answers where exactness matters: five rule families (OPT/STEM-OPT unemployment day caps — including exact deadline dates, the 60-day grace period, the H-1B cap-gap extension, STEM Designated Degree List…
Real conversation memory: follow-up questions ("what about STEM OPT?", or answering a clarifying question the assistant just asked) are understood in context, without needing to repeat yourself.

Honest about what it doesn't know: a dedicated abstain state (distinct from "off-topic" and from a computed answer) when retrieved sources don't actually support a confident answer — no answer is better than a wrong one…

Multi-source knowledge base: official government documents (USCIS, DHS/Study in the States), university guidance, and Reddit community experiences (weighted below official sources, shown separately, and refreshed…
Cost-protected: a shared trial key lets anyone try the app free (rate-limited per session and per day); bringing your own key removes the limit.
